sn49.1-12:1.5: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu anuppannānam pāpakānam akusalānaṃ dhammānam anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyam ārabhati cittam paggaṇhāti padahati || || 4.
sn49.1-12:1.6: Uppannānam pāpakānam akusalānaṃ dhammānam pahānāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyam ārabhati cittam paggaṇhāti padahati || || 5.
sn49.1-12:1.7: Anuppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānam uppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyam ārabhati cittam paggaṇhāti padahati || || 6.
sn49.1-12:1.8: uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyam ārabhati cittam paggaṇhāti padahati || || 7.
sn49.1-12:2.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave Gaṅgā nadī pācīnaninnā pācinapoṇā pācīnapabbharā ||
sn49.1-12:2.2: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu cattāro samappadhāne bhāvento cattāro sammappadhāne bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro || ||
sn49.1-12:2.3: Kathañ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu cattāro sammappadhāne bhāvento- -bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti-nibbānapabbhāro || || 9.
sn49.1-12:2.4: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu anuppannānam pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānam anuppādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyam ārabhati cittam paggaṇhāti padahati || ||
sn49.1-12:2.5: Uppannānam pāpakānam akusalānam dhammānam pahānāya chandam janeti- -padahati || ||
sn49.1-12:2.6: Anuppannānaṃ kusalānam dhammānam uppādāya chandaṃ janeti- -padahati || ||
sn49.1-12:2.7: Uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyam ārabhati cittam paggaṇhāti padahati || || 10.
sn49.1-12:2.8: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu cattāro sammappadhāne bhāvento- -bahulīkaronto nibbānaninno hoti nibbānapoṇo nibbānapabbhāro ti || || Cha pācinato ninnā || Cha ninnā ca samuddato || ete dve cha dvādasa honti ||
